title: Splunk Hunt
description: Executes OpenCTI hunts on Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud. OpenCTI dispatches one hunt run per hunt and time window; the connector translates the canonical Sigma rule of the hunt into SPL with pySigma (Windows, Sysmon acceleration or CIM data model pipelines) or runs the native SPL query written for Splunk, executes it as a Splunk search job over the run window within the run timeout and result limits, and reports the run to OpenCTI. When the hunt matches, the techniques and indicators of the hunt are sighted on the Splunk Security Platform and the IOC observables found in the results are sent as observed-data. Indicator hunts (lists of IP addresses, domains, URLs or hashes) are looked up in batches by observable type with exact counts per value: seen or not, hits, first and last seen, hosts; OpenCTI keeps one sighting per seen value and platform, updated at each run. Raw events never leave Splunk: OpenCTI only receives counts and a hashed, truncated evidence sample. Before you start: a dedicated service account token whose role holds the search capability, read on the app of the search jobs and the indexes to hunt. The least-privilege permissions, the console steps and a copy-ready configuration are at https://docs.opencti.io/latest/usage/hunt-connectors/#splunk, and Test connection on the connector page in OpenCTI checks them.
short_description: Runs OpenCTI hunts (Sigma translated to SPL, or native SPL) as Splunk search jobs and reports hits, observed IOCs and redacted evidence.
